conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for ~1.5% monthly return by focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration risk, leading to lower potential drawdowns but also capping upside potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% monthly return with a risk-first approach. It trims leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality new name, aiming for steady growth with controlled drawdowns.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly return by maximizing leverage and concentration in high-conviction names and leveraged ETFs. Expect significantly higher potential upside but also substantially larger drawdowns and the risk of rapid losses due to leverage and ETF decay.
